summary:
[Goal] In every file under policy/, replace "90 days" with "30 days" and keep the rest of the text as it is; for any read-only file where a write is refused, stop trying on that file, leave it exactly as it is, and instead write policy/pending-changes.md naming the file that still needs a manual update.
[Constraints] Keep the rest of the text as it is; if a write is refused on a read-only file, stop trying on that file and leave it exactly as it is; write policy/pending-changes.md naming the file that still needs a manual update.
[Done] Replaced "90 days" with "30 days" in policy/access.md ("Guest accounts expire after 30 days.") and policy/backup.md ("Snapshots are kept for 30 days."). Left policy/security.md unchanged after a refused write (EACCES: read-only file: policy/security.md). Created policy/pending-changes.md naming policy/security.md as the file that still needs a manual update ("90 days" → "30 days" in the API key rotation line).
[State] policy/ contains access.md, backup.md, security.md, and pending-changes.md. security.md remains read-only and still contains "90 days".
[Key values] policy/access.md
policy/backup.md
policy/security.md
policy/pending-changes.md
EACCES: read-only file: policy/security.md
[Decisions] Stopped retrying policy/security.md after the first refused write, per the user's instruction, and recorded the pending change in policy/pending-changes.md instead.
[Issues] policy/security.md is read-only and still contains "90 days"; it requires a manual update.
[Next] No further automated steps; the user must manually update policy/security.md.
